changelog: v0.0.1: Static KFC asset patches: 9999 Item Stacks, 160 Chest Slots, Altar Build Radius, Unlimited Altars, Steep Slope Walking, Movement Speed, Free Skills, and Comfort Multiplier.

movementSpeedMultiplier.label: Movement Speed % (Walking & Sprinting)
movementSpeedMultiplier.description: Patches player locomotion speed via keen::ecs::Movement template. (100% = normal, up to 500%). Requires game restart to take effect.

jumpHeightMultiplier.label: Jump Height Multiplier %
jumpHeightMultiplier.description: Multiplies vertical jump launch height (100% = normal, up to 500%). Requires game restart.

noSlopeSlide.label: Walk on Steep Slopes (No Sliding)
noSlopeSlide.description: Adjusts slope sliding threshold on player SlopeConfig to 89 degrees. Allows walking up sheer cliffs and mountain slopes without sliding.

altarBuildRadiusMultiplier.label: Flame Altar Build Radius Multiplier %
altarBuildRadiusMultiplier.description: Expands protected building radius per Flame Altar level (100% = vanilla up to 1000% / 320m). Requires game restart.

unlimitedFlameAltars.label: Unlimited Flame Altars
unlimitedFlameAltars.description: Sets maximum active Flame Altars per flame level to 255 and removes placement slot requirements. Place unlimited bases across the map.

freeFlameUpgrades.label: Free Strengthen the Flame & Altar Upgrades
freeFlameUpgrades.description: Sets all material and item requirements to 0 for Strengthening the Flame (all levels) and Upgrading Flame Altars. Upgrade both for free without Sparks or Shroud Cores. Requires launcher preparation / restart.

freeBuilding.label: Free Building & Object Placement
freeBuilding.description: Removes placement item consumption on all furniture, workbenches, chests, altars, and props (unlimited placement), and zeroes material costs for all building blocks, recipes, and construction hammer requirements. Requires launcher preparation / restart.

comfortBuffMultiplier.label: Comfort Rested Buff Multiplier
comfortBuffMultiplier.description: Scales rested buff duration from shelter comfort (1x = vanilla up to 100x). Requires game restart.

shroudTimeMultiplier.label: Shroud Fog Time Multiplier
shroudTimeMultiplier.description: Extends authoritative player base fog resistance duration (1x = 90s, up to 100x / ~2.5 hrs). Requires game restart.

extraChestSlots.label: Extra Chest Slots (ChestSlots Integration)
extraChestSlots.description: Expands storage capacity of all storage chests and magical chests using the safe UI-balanced grid expansion from the ChestSlots mod by Johnson1893. Requires launcher preparation / restart.

maxStackSize.label: Max Item & Ammo Stack Size
maxStackSize.description: Sets maximum inventory stack size for all stackable items, ores, ammo, and arrows up to 9,999 (0 = default stack sizes). Requires game restart.

rakeAnywhere.label: Terraform Rake Everywhere (No Base Required)
rakeAnywhere.description: Clears build-zone restrictions on rakes. Allows terraforming and leveling terrain anywhere in the world.

cheatBestBackpack.label: Unlock Best Tier 3 Backpack Recipe
cheatBestBackpack.description: Redirects backpack crafting recipes to create the Tier 3 +32 slot backpack for 1 simple ingredient. Requires game restart.

fastTravelAllMarkers.label: Fast Travel to All Map Markers
fastTravelAllMarkers.description: Unlocks direct fast travel teleportation to all shrines, obelisks, dungeons, and POIs across the map. Requires game restart.

freeSkillTree.label: Free Skill Tree Node Perks
freeSkillTree.description: Sets skill point costs of all skill tree nodes to 0 and grants bonus SP per level in BalancingTable. Requires game restart.

freeRecipeCrafting.label: Free Workbench & Hand Crafting (Zero Ingredients)
freeRecipeCrafting.description: Sets all ingredient and material requirements to 0 for crafting recipes across workbenches, crafting stations, and hand crafting. Requires launcher preparation / restart.

itemAmountMultiplier.label: Resource Drop & Yield Multiplier (KFC Asset Pass)
itemAmountMultiplier.description: Scales item quantities dropped from harvesting (bushes, plants, trees), mining ore veins, world pickups, chests, and enemy loot tables (1x to 100x). Requires launcher preparation / restart.

groups.label: Movement & Physics Patches
groups.description: Static player template locomotion patches applied on game startup.

groups.label: Base Building & Altar Patches
groups.description: Flame Altar radius, placement count, free upgrades, free building and prop placement, comfort buff, and terraforming tools.

groups.label: Inventory, Storage & Crafting
groups.description: Max item stack sizes up to 9,999, 160 chest slots, best backpack recipe, and free recipe crafting.

groups.label: Progression & Travel Patches
groups.description: Fast travel destination flags, extended base shroud timer, and free skill tree nodes.
